'''Liezder Towers''' was a residential building in [[Nehass]], on [[Tarhassan]]. It was at least 20 stories high and claimed to offer ''"[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] living at Tarhassan rates"''. [[Zazana Renkel]] lived there during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
